description: Minimal Minecraft domain knowledge for the Week 1 harness baseline.

terms.name: Oak Log
terms.description: A common tree block harvested from oak trees. It can be converted into planks.

terms.name: Oak Planks
terms.description: Basic processed wood used for crafting sticks, crafting tables, and wooden tools.

terms.name: Stick
terms.description: Basic crafting component used in tools and torches.

terms.name: Crafting Table
terms.description: A crafting station required for 3x3 recipes such as pickaxes.

terms.name: Wooden Pickaxe
terms.description: A basic pickaxe crafted from planks and sticks. It can mine stone-level starter blocks.

terms.name: Cobblestone
terms.description: Stone resource obtained by mining stone with a pickaxe.

terms.name: Furnace
terms.description: A block used to smelt ores and cook food.

terms.name: Zombie
terms.description: A hostile melee mob. Avoid early unless the task requires combat.

recipes.description: Craft 4 oak planks from 1 oak log in the inventory crafting grid.
Craft a crafting table from 4 planks.
Craft a wooden pickaxe with 3 planks and 2 sticks at a crafting table.
Craft a furnace with 8 cobblestone at a crafting table.

documents.title: Mineflayer Operation Guide
documents.content: The LLM must not call Mineflayer APIs directly. The harness exposes validated atomic actions. Use scan_blocks to locate relevant blocks, scan_dropped_items to locate dropped item entities, move_to to approach coordinates, dig_block_at to dig a specific block coordinate, wait_ticks to let vanilla pickup or short-lived world state update, query_inventory to inspect inventory, craft_item to craft a canonical item ID, place_block to place an inventory block, use_item to activate items or targets, fight_entity for bounded combat, and request_visual_snapshot only when structured observations are insufficient.

documents.title: Early Game Wood Chain
documents.content: A typical early-game chain is: harvest oak_log from a tree, craft oak_planks, craft stick, craft crafting_table, place the crafting_table, then craft wooden_pickaxe. Wooden pickaxe enables starter mining tasks.
